basic_info.description: Exceptional opportunity to purchase a vacant lot with incredible upside and potential to build in the exciting Excelsior district of San Francisco! 2,495 square feet (per tax records) provides the perfect canvas to explore all probable possibilities in this ideal location. Don't miss the wonderful offering in a spectacular location that is close to parks, playgrounds, shops, cafes, restaurants, HWY 101/280 and more!
